Rusty Sword.description: An old sword with a chipped blade. Better than nothing.

Oak Staff.description: A plain wooden staff, good for a beginner mage.

Iron Sword.description: A sturdy sword made by a real blacksmith.

Mage's Staff.description: A staff carved with runes that hum when you cast a spell.

Starsteel Blade.description: A blade forged from metal that fell from the sky.

Dwarven Axe.description: A heavy axe made in Harrowdeep. It never seems to dull.

Frostbrand.description: A sword of ice that never melts, taken from the heart of the Rime Colossus.

Padded Tunic.description: Thick cloth stitched in layers. It softens a blow, a little.

Leather Armor.description: Tough leather armor favored by travelers.

Chainmail.description: Linked iron rings that turn aside blades.

Furlined Cloak.description: A heavy cloak lined with wolf fur, made for the frozen north.

Dwarven Plate.description: Full plate armor hammered out by dwarven smiths.

Healing Herb.description: A bitter leaf that closes small wounds.

Minor Potion.description: A small red potion that restores some health.

Hearty Stew.description: A hot bowl of stew from Moorhold Inn.

Potion.description: A red potion that restores a good amount of health.

Greater Potion.description: A glowing potion that restores a lot of health.

Wolf Pelt.description: A wolf's fur. Merchants will buy it.

Boar Hide.description: Tough hide from a Thornback Boar.

Sentinel Core.description: A faintly glowing stone that kept the Rusted Sentinel moving.

Fen Moss.description: Damp green moss that herbalists use in potions.

Torn Page.description: A page torn from a living spellbook. The words still move.

Star Shard.description: A sliver of fallen star that is warm to the touch.

Grave Dust.description: Fine gray dust from the old battlefields.

Hound Fang.description: A long black fang from a Moor Hound.

Harpy Feather.description: A stiff feather from a Ridge Harpy.

Troll Hide.description: A thick slab of troll skin. It smells terrible.

Wyvern Scale.description: A scale as hard as steel from the Ridge Wyvern.

Frost Crystal.description: A crystal of ice that never melts.

Demon Horn.description: A curved black horn from a Demon Sentry.

Ash Ember.description: A coal from Nocthollow that still glows after it has gone cold.
